text: Bitcoin is showing modest upward momentum at $64,096 while Ethereum trails with a smaller gain, suggesting investor focus remains on the largest asset but without broad conviction across the market. The Fear & Greed Index at 28 reflects sustained bearish sentiment that has actually worsened over the past week, even as prices hold relatively steady. Bitcoin dominance at 56.5% combined with low volume of $66B indicates caution is prevailing—traders are holding positions rather than actively rotating capital into altcoins.
